craft_notes: Sthāyin: bliss-path attainment (entered-by-her on the walking-path: supreme Bhairava attained). Rows: row 3 (entered→attained). Close: attained (prāpta — the arrival verb; refrain with v84/88/110's won-forms). Rejected: 'grace' — killed: by-her-entered kept (the agency order: she enters, he is attained); 'ecstatic union' — killed: walking kept (caratā as the method inside bliss).

lines: In this walking, standing in great-bliss-path:
by her entered — supreme Bhairava attained.
l4.sanskrit_cite: asyām anucaran tiṣṭhan mahānandamaye 'dhvare | tayā devyā samāviṣṭaḥ param bhairavam āpnuyāt

reads_against.argmap: What is attained along the path? → Entered by her on the bliss-path, supreme Bhairava is attained.
c1_essence: Bliss-path walking: entered by her, Bhairava attained.
